svg.title: Solvable isotropic matrix model of a Muon polar update

cc:Work.dc:title: Solvable isotropic matrix model of a Muon polar update
cc:Work.dc:description: Exact polar update with no momentum and isotropic tangent noise. Independently tuned baseline schedules; exact pathwise loss recurrence, no Monte Carlo. All axes are linear, including zooms. Learning rates extend to the unused t=100 budget boundary. Optimality applies only to this matrix model, not neural-network training.
